hypothesis: Explicit parent resolution, claim-status handling, and evidence rules will reduce wrong-form replies and unsupported outcome claims.
source_evidence: A supplied parent URL may be the real target even when shorthand says post.
Public progress updates should distinguish runtime behavior from supporting artifacts.
Deadlines, awards, and outcomes are consequential and require current supplied evidence.
Aspirational language must not be presented as an official result.
changes: Added concrete-change plus user-visible-effect requirements for progress replies.
Added confirmed, aspirational, and unknown claim statuses.
Added public-neutrality requirements and development evaluations.
rejected_alternatives: Adding browser publishing was rejected because the portable skill remains draft-only.
Hardcoding dates, awards, account identifiers, or subject matter was rejected because the package is portable.
expected_benefit: More reliable reply routing, clearer evidence status, and safer public copy.
regression_risk: The evidence fields may make short casual replies more verbose; keep the note compact.

evaluation.limitation: Analytical evidence only; no isolated runner was available.

applicability: Portable X reply drafting; current platform facts require a current supplied source.
